envelope.reason: met while combining closed-plan-route: the commit-msg hook refused the merge(...) subject the line already carries
envelope.cause: husky commit-msg commitlint refusal on git merge -m 'merge(purview-routes): closed-plan-route'

payload.title: line merge commit subject fails commitlint type-enum
payload.body: On plan/purview-routes the combination commit 8bd6d15d is subject 'merge(purview-routes): omp-message-is-dispatch'; 'merge' is not in commitlint's type-enum, so the husky commit-msg hook refuses that subject (it refused the same shape for closed-plan-route, committed instead as 'chore(purview-routes): merge closed-plan-route'). CI's gate does not run commitlint, so the gate stays green; the subject reaches main at release. Beside the path: blocks nothing.
